Watch all the key moments from India’s clash against Argentina in the FIH Pro League 2025-26, as the visitors delivered a dominant performance to secure an 8-0 win.
Argentina controlled the tempo from the opening quarter, capitalizing on their chances and maintaining relentless pressure throughout the contest. Despite a challenging evening, Team India continued to fight, with moments of resilience and determined defending against a clinical Argentine attack.
The team will regroup, take the learnings forward, and shift focus to the upcoming fixtures in the tournament.
